description: This file defines the ActivationDataActivatorProvider class which provides mechanisms for creating and managing grain context activators within the Orleans Runtime framework, including handling of grain types, shared components, and context creation logic.

classes.name: ActivationDataActivatorProvider
classes.description: A provider class responsible for creating grain context activators based on grain types and shared context components.

classes.name: ActivationDataActivator
classes.description: A nested class within ActivationDataActivatorProvider that handles creation of individual grain activation contexts.

classes.name: StatelessWorkerActivator
classes.description: A class implementing IGrainContextActivator to create stateless worker grain contexts.

methods.name: ActivationDataActivatorProvider
methods.description: Constructor to initialize the provider with required dependencies.

methods.name: TryGet
methods.description: Attempts to retrieve an appropriate IGrainContextActivator for a given grain type.

methods.name: CreateContext
methods.description: Creates a new grain context for activation, handling instantiation and context setting.

methods.name: LogErrorFailedToConstructGrain
methods.description: Logs an error when grain construction fails.

methods.name: CreateContext
methods.description: Creates a context for a stateless worker grain.
